about_the_game:
Defender OF Falyndor is a First-Person Virtual Reality Tower Defense game where you take control of your character, towers, and much more to defend Falyndor from waves of invasions. Place and upgrade towers,  and support structures to help defend the realm or purchase some weapons and do it yourself with boots on the ground! In Defender of Falyndor, each run will be different than the last as you build your world one tile at a time and face greater and greater threats with each passing day!

FEATURES

  • First person combat against an ever-growing army of Bots who's only objectives are to bring Falyndor to ruin.

  • Visit the Item Shop to purchase upgrades for your Towers, your weapons, or yourself.

  • Visit the CID in the Command Center to permanently unlock new upgrades, towers, and deployables for the item shop.

  • Take direct control of your towers to combine your strengths and really cause some damage!

  • Choose from a selection of over 50 different tiles to build out a different world every time you play!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 3060 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • VR Support: SteamVR: Quest Headsets or Better
